title: Assessment response v0.4 (proposed, unapproved)
description: APPLICABILITY layer. Returned on every `assess` call: does a mentor's lesson fit this agent's situation? Decided per query and never written back onto the WisdomNode. The agent receives a verdict and the rules that triggered it, not the node's full text.

verdict.description: Fit of the lesson to the situation described by the agent.

abstained.description: True when the system gives no advice because the lesson does not fit.

rationale.description: Why the verdict was reached, in terms of the node's context and boundaries.

limits.description: Which parts of the situation the lesson does not cover, and qualifications carried over from partly supported claims.

attribution.description: Every node the verdict relied on, with its version and mentor.

conflicting_views.description: Other mentors' nodes that disagree. Shown alongside, never averaged into the verdict.

auto_contact.description: The system never books or contacts a human on its own. A human or authorized agent must act on the recommendation.

presents_only_grounded_content.description: The response draws only on supported or qualified claims from released nodes.

allOf.description: When the lesson does not fit: abstain, give no advice, and recommend escalation.
When the lesson fits fully or partly: do not abstain, and credit at least one node.
A partial fit must say what is not covered.
